dataset.name: US market: latest
dataset.caption: Kenneth French's daily US stock market return above the one-month T-bill rate. Window: the 750 trading days ending at the latest date in the source file (2023-09-05 to 2026-08-31); the first 250 (to 2024-08-30) are the warm-up the tool learns 'normal' from. Why this window: the latest 750 trading days in the source file, so no hindsight went into choosing it. Same rule for every real dataset. Thresholds were tuned on strategies simulated from the warm-up fit, never on these returns. Source: Kenneth R. French Data Library.
